summary: Reproduced the native assertion for zipped_divide with tilers (32, None, None) and (32, None, 40), then changed TileAttr-based zipped division to distinguish active modes, None identity modes, and layout modes beyond a lower-rank tiler. The exact logical_divide and zipped_divide result types for all three issue examples are now regression-tested against independently enumerated coordinate-to-offset mappings.
